purpose: Bounded exploratory source-sector inventory, record-level eligibility/coverage assignment and measurement-blocker prioritization

geographic_and_search_boundary.rule: All28original notices are retained in the12listed named source sectors. Additional coverage is restricted to the21explicit notice records below and the cited source sections; a whole source-map extent, aqueduct corridor or arbitrary radius is not used as the geographic cut.
geographic_and_search_boundary.source_search_scope: Existing normalizedJ01-J28/source notes; existing original AreaAC/Cypros/estate/Doq/SWP/Netzer2006 extracts at the listed pages. No new public lookup, geographic discovery search or parked acquisition.
geographic_and_search_boundary.ambiguous_physical_membership: Retained as null for every notice until an independently justified regional polygon/landscape limit exists. Named-sector inclusion is documentary only.
geographic_and_search_boundary.outside_scope: Hyrcania/other place-restoration branches and unreviewed source chapters are not evaluated; no geographical or archaeological absence is inferred.

equal_opportunity_rules.inclusion: Keep every noticed water-retaining basin/tank/cistern and hydraulic association in the selected documentary scopes, including partial, destroyed, later-only and status-unknown notices. Use no minimum size or swimming/ritual-function filter.
equal_opportunity_rules.identity: OriginalIDs are source records. Two early basinsJ01/J02 remain distinct;J03 is a later joined state. Aggregate counts and possible aliases are not individual candidate counts. Preserve all normalization relations and Cypros notice IDs; no identity collapse.
equal_opportunity_rules.phase: Feature-level dated wall/contact/surface coexistence is required for a selected use-state. A source period heading is a screen and never fixes the scroll/instruction date. Later-only notices retain possible earlier-layout unknowns.
equal_opportunity_rules.detection: A report silence or unavailable drawing is unknown. Negative excavation requires actual ancient target volume, excavation reach, preservation/disturbance and detection limits. Site coordinates and visited-site totals cannot substitute.
equal_opportunity_rules.northern: qualifies reservoir; independently justify its reference set; supplies no displacement bearing
equal_opportunity_rules.sides: Four-sided branch is defensible;large=longer and from-side relation are explicit choices/restorations. A square/nearly square report is not an automatic failure.
equal_opportunity_rules.metric_axis_status: Equal retained exploratory alternatives;none is uniquely dictated by the text. No rerun, preferred sign, extended-wall target, new coordinate or numerical fit.
equal_opportunity_rules.wall_faces: Both candidate longer sides and inner/outer faces where recoverable, at a defined ancient surface/elevation; retain square-side ambiguity.
equal_opportunity_rules.exposure: All cited sources and observations already exposed; exploratory only.
